title: Rick Falls for the Memory Trap Part 4

series.summary: Rick attempts to use evidence and armed threats to root out the parasites, but a fabricated barbecue memory infects his mind and floods the locked-down house with dozens of alien imposters.

cuts.voiceover_text: When false memories spread, physical evidence is the only defense. But photos offer zero proof. Paranoia spikes.

Jerry abandons logic, convinced Sleepy Gary is Beth's husband. Rick panics. Desperate for control, he aims his blaster at Summer. Sleepy Gary shields her. The room retaliates, chanting for Rick to remember a barbecue. The psychic pressure is relentless.
The trap works. Rick surrenders to the fake memory, happily grilling alongside Pencilvester. He is totally disarmed.
Reality returns to chaos as dozens of parasites flood the room. Sleepy Gary demands the blast shields open, but Rick refuses. Can Rick keep the infection trapped?
